description: This Java class 'EntityEcaSetField' provides functionality to set and format fields within a context map, based on XML element attributes. It includes methods for evaluating and formatting string values with various formats, such as case conversion, appending, and type conversions.

classes.name: EntityEcaSetField
classes.description: A final class that encapsulates logic for setting and formatting a field in a context map based on XML configuration.

methods.name: EntityEcaSetField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with attributes from an XML element.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates and sets the field in the provided context map based on the configured attributes and formatting rules.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a string value according to the specified format, including case conversion, appending, and type conversions.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field to be set.

methods.name: getRValue
methods.description: Returns the raw value or environment name associated with the field.
